copper_sheathing.name: Copper sheathing
copper_sheathing.description: Copper plates below the waterline. A little faster, and fouls far more slowly. Expensive.

reinforced_hull.name: Reinforced hull
reinforced_hull.description: Extra frames and planking. Much tougher, but heavier and slower.

racing_rig.name: Racing rig
racing_rig.description: Taller masts and more canvas. Faster, but it takes more hands to work her.

expanded_hold.name: Expanded hold
expanded_hold.description: Rip out a gun deck for cargo space. More hold, fewer gun ports.

better_quarters.name: Better quarters
better_quarters.description: Hammock space, a galley stove, a proper sick bay. The crew will thank you; the hold won't.

swivel_guns.name: Swivel guns
swivel_guns.description: Small rail-mounted guns that sweep a deck clear before and during boarding. Need gunners.

chase_guns.name: Chase guns
chase_guns.description: Long guns at bow and stern, for firing while chasing or fleeing.

cannons_4.name: 4-pounder guns
cannons_4.description: Light guns. Little punch, but they save weight for cargo and speed.

cannons_9.name: 9-pounder guns
cannons_9.description: A real broadside. Heavier, so a little less cargo and speed.

cannons_12.name: 12-pounder guns
cannons_12.description: Frigate guns. Smash hulls, at a cost in weight.

cannons_18.name: 18-pounder guns
cannons_18.description: Heavy guns. Only big hulls can carry them.

cannons_24.name: 24-pounder guns
cannons_24.description: Ship-of-the-line guns. Devastating, and very heavy.
